Abstract Field.description: Abstract Noise Texture based on Wire's Fractal Noise node.

Blank.description: An empty(blank) clip. Useful to insert empty moments in an Autopilot sequence.

Checkered.description: A checkerboard pattern with adjustable rows, columns and colors.

Feedback.description: Creates a feedback loop of the composition output. It continuously reuses the previous frame as part of the next one, similar to pointing a camera at its own screen. Make sure to tone down the opacity and work with content with a alpha channel to make the most of this source.

Geometry Pattern Maker.description: This patch is inspired by many of the simple shape geometry I have seen time and time again throughout my life as an artist. This patch has given me a respect for and a special understanding of shapes. The simplest forms can be beautiful and inspiring to make new what was once old to; make those things work for your deck. I hope you enjoy this patch and tinkering with it as much as I have enjoyed making it.

Golden Flicker Reel.description: Audio-reactive gold/ember reel mandala for the Golden Flicker soundtrack. Bass=core bloom, Mids=blade length, Highs=ember dots. Drive Bass/Mids/Highs via Dashboard or the Resolume webserver REST API; Perlin fallback keeps it alive when idle. Palette: gold #E7A51E, ember #E1391F, warm black #0a0705.

Gradient.description: Generates a horizontal, vertical, radial or angular gradient with either 2 colors or a palette.

Line Scape.description: A wavey line scape with adjustable wobble and jagginess.

Lines.description: A lines pattern with adjustable width, color, rotation and sharpness.

Metaballs.description: Metaballs are soft, blobby shapes that blend into each other when they get close, like drops of water merging.

React Pulsar.description: 1967 - the lighthouse in the noise. CP1919 stacked ridgelines, stateless.

React Video Musi.description: 1977 - Atari Video Music: the first consumer music visualizer, diamonds on your hi-fi.

Rings.description: A multi-layered ring shape with multiple styles.

Sine Wave.description: Generates a modulatable sine wave shape with control over many parameters such as frequency and modulation depth.

Solid Color.description: Generates a clip with a single color.

Stroboscope.description: A strobe generator with adjustable frequency.

Text Animator.description: Creates an animated text clip. Allows for the animation of characters, lines, words or the entire text block.

Text Block.description: Draws your text to the screen. Great for labels, names or mid-show poetry.

Video Router.description: Reroutes the output from any other layer or group to the Video Router, allowing you to patch video signals between layers. Useful for creating modular setups without duplicating content. Defaults to rerouting the layer below.
